name: LinkToText
tagline: Free Instagram Transcript Generator — Reels to Text
description: LinkToText is a free Instagram transcript generator. Paste a public Reel or video link to convert Instagram video to text with Whisper-powered speech recognition and AI cleanup. Use the transcript for captions, SRT/VTT subtitle drafts, AI summaries, translation, content repurposing, and research — without rewatching.
